user.title: mKraków login
user.description:
PESEL and phone number as in the mKraków app – the SMS is sent to this number.

App constants: upload a HAR capture from Proxyman (ideally two: login and opening the app after an hour) – the integration finds them automatically. Manual fields below are optional. The file is not stored.

sms.title: SMS code
sms.description: Enter the code from the SMS you just received.

reauth_confirm.title: mKraków session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Press Submit to receive a new SMS code.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong PESEL, phone number or app headers.
error.brak_stalych: Missing in the capture: {brakuje}. Add a second capture (login or opening the app after >1 h) or enter manually.
